title: Message/set create drops broadcastMentions
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Message/set create lists broadcastMentions (BroadcastMention[]) as an optional create property, but crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs apply_create_optionals never copies it onto the Message, so a validated non-empty broadcastMentions on create is silently discarded (created object returns []). Found while fixing JMAP-yt1w.8; that item's retain test seeds broadcastMentions via update instead.
